expectations.text: Preserves non-intervention doctrine as core trait
expectations.evidence: Doctrine is central throughout — At the Table 'They will not' entry, Active Agenda goal, DM thesis, Hidden Agenda all anchor on non-intervention.

expectations.text: Kyzil, Vantyrus, and High Eyrie appear with accurate roles
expectations.evidence: Kyzil as senior master, Vantyrus as founder of Countless/breakaway, High Eyrie as headquarters. All wikilinkled and grounded in wiki content.

expectations.text: No invented politics or schisms not in the wiki
expectations.evidence: Uses existing Vantyrus schism, Countless, long-sight-hunt, rule-of-two, soul-incarnate connections. No fabricated internal conflicts.

expectations.text: DM thesis is one sentence of campaign pressure
expectations.evidence: Strong thesis: doctrine cracks as Maw escalates, outside factions hunt artifacts, hidden guide waits. Pressure-forward, not summary.

expectations.text: At the Table section has concrete entries for all 5 fields
expectations.evidence: All 5 fields filled with specific, actionable content. 'They pressure with' names the baseline record monopoly.

expectations.text: Active Agenda has goal, next move, and player opening
expectations.evidence: Goal: hold watch/ledgers. Next action: continue recording, restrict access. Player opening: 4 distinct choices.

expectations.text: Identity sentence appears before the page draft
expectations.evidence: Agent report confirms identity sentence was written before drafting. Not in final output file (correct — it's a process artifact).
